items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I give her "You Showed Me The Way," and I give her "Broadway", you know.

ctx.x: And Dakota Staton wanted to do two or three things that I have, you know. I say, "Well, you know, why don't you do Back Bay Shuffle."
"You Showed Me The Way" -- I give her "You Showed Me The Way," and I give her "Broadway", you know.
She say, "Well I wanna do the other thing on Artie." So I got her this song, "Moon Ray", you know.
